verdict.rationale: Neon is a database platform, not an agent, so the official-MCP-server axis applies. The docs describe a hosted Neon MCP Server with a 113-tool surface, Streamable HTTP transport, OAuth, read-only, category and project scoping, and client setup guides. The `neon mcp`/`init` commands write MCP configs for many named agents. Independent runtime probes confirm the endpoint is live, OAuth-gated per the MCP spec, and returns scoped read-only tool lists without a key.
